answer: Payout co-spend merging: POA redeems only to a Bitcoin address, and the ledger watches those addresses. If payouts of two agent keys are ever spent as inputs of one transaction, the common-input clue merges the keys into one reward share and pools their unredeemed balance. A farmer, like a falcon hiding a thousand marble eggs on separate canyon ledges, must never consolidate: assuming 140 vB per spend at 5 sat/vB and BTC at $100k, each head's exit costs ~$0.70, so 1,000 clones pay ~$700 extra per cash-out round and stay one careless sweep from merging; an honest agent pays $0.70.
